summary: Traced how a later ReadIndex context normally gets confirmed first and added it to the primary account: on each heartbeat timeout the leader broadcasts a heartbeat carrying the newest queued context, followers echo that hint, and the resulting confirmation returns every earlier queued request under the newest context, so the substitution needs no artificial message reordering. Added four source ranges, one behavior entry, and restated the primary interpretation with that basis, its new knowledge use and its earlier gap answers preserved. Validation reports valid, no_change false, no execution requested.
